verdict.rationale: Make provides a documented Custom Apps platform (App components: Base, Connections, Webhooks, Modules, Remote Procedure Calls) plus a REST API for building custom connectors/integrations, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: no confirmed official CLI or OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json and a broken docs-md page), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of connector-building success.
